================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO YA AFTER EFFECTS - IBISHYA BIRIMO
Verisiyo 9.2.8  -  Ukwakira 2026
================================================================================

Panel ubu iraboneka mu NDIMI 132, hari INSANGANYAMATSIKO nshya za DEMON SLAYER
zifite inkota ica amabuto ukanze, hamwe n'ibikosorwa bike ku miterere no kuri Windows.

MBERE YO GUTANGIRA
- Shyiraho hejuru ya verisiyo ufite ukoresheje ZXP installer usanzwe, hanyuma
  ongera utangire After Effects rimwe.
- Igenamiterere ryawe, insanganyamatsiko, presets n'expressions wabitse biragumaho.

NSHYA: PANEL MU NDIMI 132
- Igenamiterere rya Flex > URURIMI ubu rurimo indimi 132, hamwe n'aho gushakira.
  Hitamo rumwe maze panel yose ihinduke: tabs, amabuto, tooltips, ubutumwa.
- Buri rurimi rwahinduwe na AI ruvuye kuri panel y'Icyongereza, ntibyakozwe
  ijambo ku rindi. Amazina ubona muri project yawe (amazina ya layers, amazina ya
  effects) aguma mu Cyongereza kugira ngo agume ahura na After Effects.
- Popup ya "ibishya birimo" na yo irahindurwa, guhera kuri iyi verisiyo.

NSHYA: INSANGANYAMATSIKO ZA DEMON SLAYER
- Igenamiterere rya Flex > GUHITAMO INSANGANYAMATSIKO rifite itsinda rishya rya
  DEMON SLAYER ririmo insanganyamatsiko 11: Giyu, Hinokami Kagura, Shinobu,
  Mitsuri, Rengoku, Zenitsu, Nezuko, Muichiro, Inosuke, Tengen na Kokushibo.
- Wimure mouse hejuru ya panel maze igice cy'insanganyamatsiko kiyikurikire:
  amazi, amakara y'umuriro, imirabyo, ibinyugunyugu, amababi y'indabo, igihu
  n'ibindi. Mouse iyo ihagaze, kirayoyoka buhoro.
- Kanda buto maze inkota y'uwo mukinnyi iyice. Komeza ufate buto y'ibumoso
  inkota ikomeze gukata; uyifashe nk'amasegonda 2.5 iraturika.
- Byakozwe kugira ngo bigume byoroshye: effects zikora gusa iyo wimuye mouse
  cyangwa ukanze, kandi zirigabanya ubwazo kuri mudasobwa zitinda. Zimya
  EFFECTS Z'IBIDUKIKIJE muri Guhitamo Insanganyamatsiko kugira ngo usigarane amabara gusa.

BIHINDUWE: BUTO ZIDAFITE IGICUCU MU NSANGANYAMATSIKO ZOSE
- Buto zikora n'iz'ingenzi mu nsanganyamatsiko z'amabara ntizigikoresha igicucu
  kigenda kiva hejuru kijya hasi. Ubu zifite ibara rimwe ridafite igicucu hamwe
  n'urumuri rworoheje, bityo zisa neza kandi zisomeka neza.

BYAKOSOWE
- Ikarita y'uruhushya na popup ya "ibishya birimo" byashoboraga gufunguka kimwe
  hejuru y'ikindi. Ubu ntibigisumbana, kandi ikimenyetso cya UPDATE ntikigipfukirana
  amabuto yo hejuru ya panel.
- Kuri IGIPIMO CYA UI 125% na 150%, amadirishya amwe (nka Igenamiterere rya Flex)
  yashoboraga kurenza panel uburebure, bigatuma buto yo kuyafunga itagaragara. Ubu
  buri dirishya rijyana n'ibipimo byose.
- Windows: AutoCaptions yashoboraga kuvuga ngo "DRIVER YA NVIDIA IRASHAJE CYANE KURI
  CAPTIONS ZA GPU" ku makarita na drivers nshya (RTX 40 na 50). Ubu isoma neza
  ubufasha bwa CUDA bwa driver kandi ikoresha GPU yawe.

NTA CYAHINDUTSE
- Uruhushya, activation n'imiyoboro yose bikora nk'uko byahoze.
- Izindi tabs n'ibikoresho byose bikora nk'uko byakoraga muri 9.2.7.
================================================================================

ult.message:
FLEX ULTIMATE YA PREMIERE PRO - IBISHYA BIRIMO
Verisiyo 2.2.8  -  Ukwakira 2026

Captions za CAPTION STACK ubu ni templates za Motion Graphics ZIGUHINDURWA zifite
editor nyayo, hari AUDIO STUDIO nshya na MARK AUDIO BEATS, panel iraboneka mu
NDIMI 132, IGIPIMO CYA UI cyaje muri ULTIMATE, kandi hari INSANGANYAMATSIKO nshya za DEMON SLAYER.

MBERE YO GUTANGIRA
- Shyiraho hejuru ya verisiyo ufite ukoresheje ZXP installer usanzwe, hanyuma
  ongera utangire Premiere Pro rimwe.
- Igenamiterere ryawe, insanganyamatsiko na presets biragumaho.

NSHYA: CAPTION STACK - CAPTIONS ZIGUHINDURWA (FX & ADV RIGS > CAPTION STACK)
- Captions ubu zishyirwaho nka templates za Motion Graphics ziguhindurwa (Output >
  MOGRT IGUHINDURWA, ni yo isanzwe nshya muri Premiere Pro 2026). Nyuma yo kuzishyiraho,
  hindura ijambo iryo ari ryo ryose, font, ibara, ingano, aho riri, glow, umurongo w'inyuma,
  agasanduku, animation cyangwa igihe muri panel ya Essential Graphics ya Premiere.
- Output > AMAFOTO iracyashyiraho buri jambo nk'ifoto ifite isura nyayo,
  niba ubishaka.
- Templates ziza hamwe na panel. Nta kintu cyo gukuramo.

NSHYA: CAPTION STACK EDITOR
- Preview ubu yerekana ifoto nyayo ya videwo yawe munsi ya buri caption.
- Kurura caption kugira ngo uyimure, koresha inguni kugira ngo uyihindure ingano
  n'akadomo ko hejuru kugira ngo uyizunguze, kanda kabiri ku ijambo kugira ngo urihindure.
  CAPTION YOSE yimura amagambo yose hamwe, IJAMBO RIMWE ryimura ijambo rimwe gusa.
- Hitamo niba impinduka zikoreshwa kuri captions zose cyangwa kuri caption iyi
  gusa, maze ubike layouts zawe kugira ngo uzongere kuzikoresha.
- Isura 10 nshya za GLOW: Big Wide, Bounce Lime, Candy, Horror, Hook, Typewriter,
  Editorial, Sunset, Slide Yellow na Superb.

NSHYA: AUDIO STUDIO (FX & ADV RIGS > AUDIO STUDIO)
- Hitamo clip y'amajwi, hitamo effect maze ukande KORESHA. Byose bikorera
  kuri mudasobwa yawe.
- Presets 30 zikoreshwa ukanze rimwe: Underwater, Bass Boost, reverb ya Room /
  Hall / Cathedral / Plate, Echo, Telephone, Radio, Megaphone, Robot, Chipmunk,
  Deep Voice, Nightcore, Slowed + Reverb, 8D Audio, Lo-fi, Reverse n'izindi.
  Shyira effects nyinshi uko ushaka, uzihindurire imyanya cyangwa uzimye imwe.
- Reverb igumana umurizo wayo: ijwi rikomeza kumvikana nyuma y'iherezo rya clip,
  kandi ishyirwa mu buryo nta kintu kiri kuri timeline yawe gisimburwa.
- Ibikoresho: Noise Remover, Voice Enhance, Loudness (-14 / -16 / -23 LUFS),
  De-esser, De-click, De-clip, Hum Remover, Compressor, Limiter, EQ, Speed
  na Pitch, Noise Gate, Extract Audio.
- STEMS MAKER itandukanya indirimbo ikavamo amajwi n'umuziki (cyangwa stems 4).
  Ikuramo model yayo ku nshuro ya mbere kandi iragusaba uruhushya mbere.
- PREVIEW igufasha kumva nk'amasegonda 8 ufite uburyo bwo guhinduranya Original / Processed.
  Igisubizo gishyirwa kuri track y'amajwi ifunguye kandi clip yawe y'ibanze
  irahagarikwa ijwi, ntisibwa na rimwe.

NSHYA: MARK AUDIO BEATS (FX & ADV RIGS > MARK AUDIO BEATS)
- Hitamo clip y'umuziki kuri timeline maze ukande MARK BEATS: Flex ibona
  beats ikazishyiraho markers za sequence, bityo ibice ukata bihura neza
  n'umuziki.
- Hitamo hits ZOSE, KICKS cyangwa SNARES, shyiraho sensitivity, maze ushyireho
  ikimenyetso kuri buri beat cyangwa kuri buri beat ya 2 cyangwa ya 4.
- REMOVE BEAT MARKERS isiba gusa markers Flex yongeyeho. Ikorera kuri
  mudasobwa yawe.

NSHYA: PANEL MU NDIMI 132
- Igenamiterere > URURIMI ubu rurimo indimi 132, hamwe n'aho gushakira. Tabs,
  amabuto, tooltips n'ubutumwa byose birahinduka. Popup ya "ibishya birimo" na
  yo irahindurwa, guhera kuri iyi verisiyo.

NSHYA: IGIPIMO CYA UI
- Igenamiterere > IGIPIMO CYA UI gituma panel yose iba nini cyangwa nto, nko muri
  Flex GUI Pro. Buri dirishya rijyana n'ibipimo byose.
